name: Shimei
title: Benjamite from Bahurim
summary: Shimei was a man from the tribe of Benjamin and the father of Shimi, who is known for cursing King David when he fled from Absalom. Shimei is mentioned in genealogies that link him to Saul's lineage and the house of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Shimi's lineage
keyEvents.description: Shimei is presented as the father of Shimi, a Benjamite from Bahurim, who cursed David during his flight from Absalom.

keyEvents.title: Shimi's cursing of David
keyEvents.description: Shimei's son Shimi threw stones at David and cursed him when the king fled from Absalom, calling him a man of blood.

keyEvents.title: Shimi's submission upon David's return
keyEvents.description: After Absalom's defeat, Shimei's son Shimi hurried to meet David at the Jordan and asked for forgiveness for his curse.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Solomon's reckoning with Shimei
keyEvents.description: Shimi, son of Shif, was warned by Solomon to stay in Jerusalem but broke the agreement and was executed, as part of David's final instructions.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shifi is mentioned in Benjamin's genealogies in 1 Chronicles as part of the Benjamite lineage.
